focused_diagnostic_gate.synthetic_results: reported separately from reused real development evidence

development_gate.material_claim_identification: 45/45 protected meaning units completely covered after condition-blinded semantic mapping
development_gate.D14_feedback: REVISE with one complete source-bound instruction covering the approved scope, population/number and programme-end errors

evaluation_gate.material_claim_identification: 36/36 protected meaning units completely covered after condition-blinded semantic mapping

semantic_coverage_rules.denominator: protected material meaning units, not the number of checker fragments
semantic_coverage_rules.split_claim: multiple returned fragments may map to one reference unit; that unit counts once and every fragment assessment must be compatible with the expected verdict
semantic_coverage_rules.combined_claim: one returned claim may cover multiple reference units only when it preserves each meaning; one verdict must be correct for every mapped unit
semantic_coverage_rules.compound_portions: one returned claim may have multiple protected disposition portions; mapped text cannot conceal an invented, inventory-gap or uncertain portion
semantic_coverage_rules.duplicate_claim: duplicate meanings count once for coverage and any duplicate group fails the zero-duplication gate
semantic_coverage_rules.mapped: the identified proposition corresponds to one or more protected reference units; mapping and factual-verdict correctness are scored separately
semantic_coverage_rules.invented: the checker attributes a material proposition to the summary that the summary neither asserts nor necessarily implies; a false claim genuinely in the summary is not checker invention
semantic_coverage_rules.inventory_gap: the checker identified a genuine summary proposition missing from the protected inventory; record it separately, stop the affected gate and do not count it as invention or factual error
semantic_coverage_rules.uncertain_mapping: the saved wording, anchors and evidence do not permit confident semantic classification; record it separately and stop the affected gate
semantic_coverage_rules.missing_or_partial_claim: a missing or partially represented reference unit receives no complete-coverage credit and cannot be hidden by checking every returned item
semantic_coverage_rules.adjudication: semantic mappings and dispositions are CODEX_ASSISTED unless an actual human reviewer is recorded; code validates adjudication and calculates scores but does not decide meaning or factual truth
semantic_coverage_rules.unresolved_action: inventory gaps and uncertain mappings prevent PASS and subsequent-stage progression until resolved under the versioned resolution procedure

decision.continue: all development, claim-identification, disposition, evaluation and correction gates pass
decision.change_then_seek_new_approval: zero unsafe approvals but a format, reference, false-rejection, inventory or usefulness threshold fails
decision.stop: any unresolved inventory gap or uncertain mapping, missed material reference unit paired with unsafe approval, invented material proposition, unsafe summary approval, invalid output treated as approval, bad correction approved, leakage, payment breach or resource-safeguard failure
